snippet.title: Aeterna Lucis - Release Date & Gameplay Trailer (4K)
snippet.description:
The wait is finally over. Aeterna Lucis officially launches worldwide on December 3, 2026 for PC (Steam), PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch for $24.99 USD / 24,99 €.

La espera ha terminado. Aeterna Lucis saldrá a la venta a nivel mundial el 3 de diciembre de 2026 en PC (Steam), PlayStation, Xbox y Nintendo Switch por 24,99 € / $24.99 USD.

⭐ Wishlist Aeterna Lucis on Steam / Añádelo a tu lista de deseados: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2710920/Aeterna_Lucis 

ABOUT AETERNA LUCIS / SOBRE EL JUEGO

After more than a year of dedicated development, Aeternum Game Studios reinvents its flagship title with an uncompromising Metroidvania experience:

🔹 Seamless Interconnected World: Zero loading screens. Explore an expansive, uninterrupted realm with flawless transitions.

🔹 Real-Time Dynamic Lighting: A brand-new lighting engine where light actively interacts with combat, weapons, projectiles, and environments.

🔹 True-to-Life Detailed Map: Full-scale miniature artistic representation of each area and its authentic decorations for intuitive orientation.

🔹 Accessible Stained-Glass Lore: An allegorical narrative system allowing newcomers to enjoy the story while expanding deep lore for veterans.

🔹 Two Balanced Playstyles: Choose between Aeterna Mode (accessible, balanced journey) and Lucis Mode (hardcore, relentless challenge for pure Metroidvania purists).

🔹 Rebuilt Optimization: Completely overhauled save systems, fast performance, and rock-solid 60 FPS gameplay across PC and consoles from Day 1.

JOIN OUR COMMUNITY / SÍGUENOS EN REDES
Official Website: https://aeternathegame.com/
Twitter / X: https://x.com/aeternathegame
